# Old-format table in which EVERY data row is an "(all equal)" no-change row.
# These rows are data, not footnotes -- but they contain the words "all equal"
# and "samples", so a footnote filter written as a substring match discards them,
# the table parses to zero rows, and the gate reports a spurious exit 2
# ("cannot interpret") on a comparison that was in fact perfectly clean.
# Anchoring the footnote filter on the LEADING superscript is what keeps these.
name                       old allocs/op  new allocs/op  delta
EnvGet-4                      128k ± 0%      128k ± 0%     ~     (all equal)
Parser/diff.lisp-4           4.23k ± 0%     4.23k ± 0%     ~     (all equal)
MacroDefun-4                  2.00 ± 0%      2.00 ± 0%     ~     (all equal)
